title: Web Hosting Plans Schedule of Cancellation and Refund Terms
content:
Web Hosting Plans carry the following cancellation and refund figures. They are the same on every tier.

| Term | Harborline Starter | Harborline Plus | Harborline Pro | Harborline Business | Harborline Cloud 4 | Harborline Cloud 8 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Money-back period after the opening date, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Shortest billing term covered by the money-back guarantee, months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Most hosting money-back refunds per customer in a trailing 365 days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Auto-renew refund period after the charge of a 12-month or longer term, calendar days | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| A 1-month term renewal can be refunded | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| The 1-month setup fee is refunded under the money-back or auto-renew refund rules | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Default refund destination when the customer states no preference | original payment method | original payment method | original payment method | original payment method | original payment method | original payment method |

**What the figures measure**

- The money-back period counts calendar days after the plan's opening date within which an immediate cancellation is refunded under the money-back guarantee.
- The 365-day figure is the largest number of hosting money-back refunds one customer may receive in a trailing 365 days.
- The auto-renew refund period counts calendar days after an auto-renew charge of a 12-month or longer term within which it may be refunded.
- The setup fee row concerns the money-back and auto-renew refund rules only; a failed order is always refunded in full.
- The default destination is where a hosting refund goes when the customer states no preference.
